description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Refia)] and [Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Refia)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Fire abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Refia)], grants [Damage Cap +10000 3], [100% Critical 3] and [Critical Damage +50% 3] if the combined number of FF3 allies and non-FF3 allies with any Attach Fire is 4+
